checks: Only the requested investigation opens; the native chooser lists the same branch, retains keyboard focus and Tab navigation, and changes no saved content.
Title and multiline findings survive switching; one Save preserves every other field, branch, conclusion and brief.
An invalid hidden investigation stays in the draft and blocks saving until corrected.
Switching investigations retains conflict protection and human wording; explicit discard adopts the newer saved finding.
Removing the selected item falls back to a remaining item, a single item hides the chooser, Add selects the new draft, and Undo restores the prior work.
Complete HTML/JSON exports retain every investigation; the reopened selector and save controls fit a 390px panel.
